name: sensor_modal_evidence
description: Measure a visible flat patch in 3D instead of manually interpreting repeated depth queries. Choose camera and region_rc=[row_start,column_start,row_end,column_end] at native resolution; ends exclusive, 4x4 minimum, 4096 pixels maximum. Uses the latest frame unless step is supplied (latest four only). Returns world centre, camera-facing unit normal, depth support and fit errors; unknown for insufficient/mixed/curved support. Select one surface, avoiding edges and occlusion. The normal is a measured surface direction, not automatically an object axis, movement direction or insertion depth.
